purpose: Connect Learning Progress attendance ownership to the accepted Financial Ledger reconciliation boundary.

anti_goals: Learning Progress must not write charge, allocation, balance, or audit rows directly.
Do not add a third attendance state.
constraints: Learning Progress owns attendance; Financial Ledger owns financial state.
Use an explicit transaction and safe isolated fixtures.
invariants: A failed correction leaves attendance and financial state unchanged.

stop_conditions: Stop if reconciliation needs a new cross-slice edge or ownership decision.
